test: Identify POs with two bills of identical amount and different vendor_invoice_no. Order the pair by day (second = later bill). Check: share of second bills paid, by year and vendor; whether the PO had exactly one WMS receipt and bill lines duplicate the PO lines (same SKU/qty); whether any vendor credit of the same vendor with amount near the second bill amount (or summed credits) follows within 60/180 days. Size paid second-bill dollars per year.
support: Most second bills (>70%) paid, rate stable across years and vendors; one receipt per PO with receipt qty = PO qty; bill lines identical on both bills; essentially no vendor credits matching vendor+amount after the second bill.
weaken: Second bills correspond to a second receipt or different lines; or matching vendor credits follow; or the pattern concentrates in special POs that lack receipts (where a second delivery could be invisible); or the timing between bills suggests a re-issue that replaced the first (e.g., first bill unpaid).
expect: Strongly expect support (~80% confidence): map says 2,388 of 2,858 bills paid, and vendor credits total only ~1.9M across all vendors and are per-SKU tied to returns, so recovery is unlikely. Expect ~$0.27M/yr paid on second bills. Uncertainty: special POs have no receipts, so second-delivery check is weaker there; and whether both bills are paid vs one.
